description:
Hands on development experience with TIBCO BW 6.3, TIBCO EMS and TIBCO API exchange. 
 Other preferred TIBCO skills include TIBCO Enterprise Admin, TIBCO Hawk 5.2, TIBCO Policy Director 2. 
 Working knowledge and experience in WebMethods integration tool is a big plus since this project is a migration from webmethods to TIBCO BW. 
 However, not expected to work on webmethods environment in this project. 
 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
